messages:
Anya: Quick sync — drafting a compatibility roadmap for the convo format. We need to decide scope: strict messages/roles-first vs a hybrid prompt-adapter approach. Thoughts?

Devon: TL;DR: messages-first is cleaner for tooling (roles, system/user/assistant) but harder for customers who use prompt strings today.

Luca: Messages format gives us better model routing and KV-cache hints. Also less fragile for function/tool calling.

Sam: Customer ask: some big customers send prompt blobs and rely on tokens-in-prompt parsing. Moving them to messages will be a migration pain.

Tess: UX angle — if we require explicit roles we should give simple shims in SDKs (convert prompt->messages) and a migration warning in console.

Anya: Agreed. Proposal A: messages-first native with an opt-in compatibility header. Proposal B: two-mode API that accepts prompt and messages but documented as legacy.

Devon: Performance note: prompt mode bypasses some batching/cache optimizations. That affects SLA on Dedicated. Need to call out perf delta in docs.

Luca: Also need to lock down system role semantics. Is system content single string or structured list? If we allow structured, it helps tool chaining.

Sam: For function/tool calling we should define exact contract now. Customers expect deterministic outputs for the JSON schema tools. If roles are ambiguous, tool-calls break.

Tess: Can we ship a schema-driven "system": {"policy": "<string>", "metadata": {}} as v1-opt? Or is that too heavy?

Devon: I'd avoid structured system in v1. Ship plain system string and a separate structured-output feature flag that pairs with function-calling. Simpler rollout.

Anya: Launch criteria suggested: 1) SDK adapters for prompt->messages in JS/Python, 2) perf benchmark doc for both modes, 3) E2E regressions for top 10 customers, 4) canary rollout support and an experimental header.

Sam: For the experimental header, prototype:
```
Accept: application/redwood-convo+json; version=1-experimental
```
Would allow us to change shape before GA.

Luca: Ops note: we need routing rules to prefer message-optimized kernels. Add a flag in routing policy.

Anya: Prioritization — customers asking for structured output + tool-calling are highest. Messaging-only firms are numerous but lower touch. Recommend we prioritize function-calling + structured output in the first wave, with messages v2 after SDK coverage.

Devon: Can we commit an explicit deprecation migration path if we keep prompt mode? e.g., 12mo notice, automatic SDK conversion for customers who opt in.

Tess: Will design own banner copy for Console to show which mode (messages vs prompt) a route is using. Need copy by next Thurs.

Sam: Ops-bot: added backlog ticket INF-4021 for compatibility adapters and INF-4022 for experimental header support.

Anya: Next steps: Sam to spec header and function-call contract, Devon to size SDK adapters, Luca to add perf impact doc. I'll draft the roadmap doc and share by EOD Friday. If anyone is strongly opposed to messages-first, speak up now.

Devon: Not opposed, just want migration guarantees.

Luca: Fine with messages-first as long as we ship adapters + perf doc.

Tess: Fine. Will mock Console banners Monday.

Anya: Cool — thanks everyone. I'll spin up the roadmap PR and link tickets.

ops-bot: Ticket INF-4021 created: "Compatibility adapters: prompt->messages"
ops-bot: Ticket INF-4022 created: "Experimental Accept header: convo v1"
